scope.scopeDescription: M2 S1 E009 Q21 explicit currentDefinitionApplication transport and its write/replay/native-reuse lifecycle; actual operation remains separate

reviewedInvariants.reason: The caller clones native row.after. The opt-in requires the original SHA-bound m2-s1 review, selected REGISTRATION_PENDING/CORRECT item and explicit empty proposalRefs, and rejects any actual native proposal selecting the UID or external native proposal inventory. It does not alter or fabricate the original native item/after/proposal list.

Root definition, original independent review and application sidecar are all exact local-and-immutable-commit SHA refs, each bound in both approval and selected item evidence. Reviewer identities must be distinct from root, preparer and native author; native item, source snapshots, definition hash and approval boundaries are cross-checked. The unchanged original M3 independent review bytes were separately confirmed.

The existing native semantic/source/content/difficulty gates run first. The helper additionally permits only the one exact PT_TPL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE registration debt, rejects source/content/difficulty holds and sourceIssueHold/sourceDefectCandidate, limits this version to text-only evidence, and retains all five native finalDifficulty fields. Source approval flags remain equal to the immutable before source; no new source-quality or full-math approval is asserted.

Both native snapshots and the current source have identical protected student payload. The initial current evidence snapshot reconstructs the entire selected question from the approved pre-edit question with exactly seven set fields and four exact obsolete annotation removals; unselected questions in those two initial snapshots must remain identical. The returned standardCourse is only the exact already-declared native/current source and approved binding value, not an extra source mutation.

Only the approved new template under a byte-for-byte unchanged existing ACTIVE parent and one exact add-only MIDDLE2 binding are admitted. Registry changes must be exactly these two objects. Current MIDDLE2 scope must actually include 2022 and M2-1; a pending extension is not treated as registered. Original and direct RPM rows and the exact current LOCKED leaf are independently checked.

Retained primaryMethod/decisiveStep are labeled CURRENT_DEFINITION_APPLICATION_UNCHANGED_NATIVE_SOURCE; new RPM aliases are labeled CURRENT_DEFINITION_APPLICATION_NATIVE_RPM_ALIAS; standardCourse gets UNCHANGED_NATIVE_AND_CURRENT_SOURCE_EXACT_BINDING. These fields do not acquire a false NATIVE_AFTER origin. New PT/TPL authority is explicit in the currentDefinitionApplication proof rather than retroactive native approval.

The new opt-in is included in the shared typed binding inventory. Write requires an exact selected source-review proof and stores a durable SHA-bound request/repair sidecar. Replay checks its inventory/digest/provenance, restores only the originally added exact template/binding in read-only lookup maps, reruns the entire proof and requires equality. Native reuse imports the same opt-in inventory, detects durable obligations and validates the original request/proof, so erased proof/sidecar cannot fall back to ordinary approval.

Selected RPM record/direct-row/leaf proof hashes remain exact while unrelated crosswalk additions do not change this compound proof. Later source-only descendants must keep the full selected question and denominator identical; current live selected question is read again. The initial whole-blob request remains fixed, while a supported new sourceRebind request and actual receipt chain provide later whole-file binding. Initial evidence cannot silently include unselected source edits.

The new helper returns null when absent. The contract accepts only one explicit ordinary PARTIAL_UIDS FINAL_QA item and excludes identity-only, sourceRebind, item rebind, renderer, retained-field, scope-field and proposal-finalization combinations. The existing RPM source declaration guard is unchanged.
